data.change_summary: Implemented the two pending carbonate follow-ups in `tank_core`. `WaterState::default_for_volume_l` and `WaterState::from_source_profile_for_volume_l` now initialize `bicarbonate_mg_total` to `0.0` with an inline note that it is solver-derived and immediately populated by `resolve_carbonate_state`, removing the misleading placeholder/profile assignment. I also expanded the nitrification-stage comment in `nitrogen_cycle.rs` to document the intentional coupling to the subsequent chemistry step: alkalinity mutates first, then the chemistry step re-resolves carbonate state, so any system inserted between those stages must not read cached `water.ph` or `bicarbonate_mg_total`.
outstanding_risks: `solve_carbonate_equilibrium()` still uses the freshwater-focused approximation with fixed `Ka2`, so any extension beyond the intended pH 5.5-8.5 aquarium envelope should revisit the chemistry model.
Legacy saves with custom out-of-range source-water catalog entries still deserialize, but runtime water-change actions against those profiles fail validation until the profile is corrected.
The unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory remains in the worktree and was left untouched.

steps.description: Inspect `water.rs` and `nitrogen_cycle.rs` to verify the pending amendments were still missing and identify the exact constructor/comment sites to change.

Patch the water constructors so `bicarbonate_mg_total` starts at `0.0` as a solver-derived cache, and expand the nitrogen-cycle coupling comment to warn about stale carbonate caches before the chemistry step runs.
Run formatting and full workspace validation, then confirm the resulting tracked worktree only contains the intended source edits.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core -p tank_data -p tank_scenarios` passed across the full workspace suites.
`cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_data -p tank_scenarios --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

`git status --short` after validation showed only the intended tracked edits in `crates/tank_core/src/types/water.rs` and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs`, plus the pre-existing unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory.
